requirements_summary: Need a real-time agent assist solution with streaming token-level suggestions. SLOs: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 150ms per suggestion; end-to-end response for a 2-turn suggestion under 200ms typical. Target concurrency for first POC: 60-120 concurrent agents per region, burst handling to 1,800 concurrent (25x spike). Tool-calling: must support structured arguments, validation, and user confirmation flow; every tool call must produce an audit trail (token-level provenance). Data must remain in customer VPC/on-prem with KMS/HSM for keys; 30-day immutable audit logs and optional 12-month retention. Prefer ability to run quantized open models on dedicated GPU pools and fall back to a smaller hosted variant during outages. Require autoscale with predictable warm pools and canary rollout for model changes.
